site.tagline: Scheduling for people who get paid
site.description: Publish event types, take free or paid bookings, and run memberships from a hosted page or embed. Built for coaches, clinics, consultants, tutors, salons, and trainers.

paid.title: Price the slot. Hold it. Collect proof.
paid.body: Paid event types can require a transfer receipt. The slot stays held for 30 minutes while the invitee uploads. If nothing arrives, the hold expires and the hour goes back on the board.

credits.title: Memberships, not just one-offs
credits.body: Period credits for tutors and trainers. Clients buy a plan, book without paying per visit, and refill when the period rolls.

hours.title: Hours that respect the real calendar
hours.body: Weekly rules, split shifts, date overrides, buffers, min notice, daily caps. Conflict-checked against Google Calendar.

page.title: A hosted page. Your URL.
page.body: schedflow.com/'{'org'}'/'{'event'}' — timezone picker, month grid, questions, then confirm or pay. Pro can hide the badge.

embed.title: Or drop it on the site you already have
embed.body: Inline embed or a popup button. Same booking flow, no second design system to maintain.

1.title: Stand up an event type
1.body: Duration, location, buffers, custom questions. Leave it free, attach a price, or require an active membership.

2.title: Share the page — or embed it
2.body: Copy your hosted link, or drop the inline snippet on the site you already run. Invitees never create an account.

3.title: They pick a time in their zone
3.body: Slots are computed in UTC, shown in the invitee’s IANA timezone, DST-safe. Days without openings stay disabled.

4.title: Collect payment proof in the same motion
4.body: Turn on payment instructions and optional receipt upload. Invitees transfer using your details, upload proof, and you confirm from the dashboard.

5.title: Calendar and email take it from there
5.body: Confirmation, .ics, Google write-back, 24h and 1h reminders. Reschedule and cancel from signed links in the email.

1.title: Hold the interval
1.body: A receipt-required slot stays reserved for 30 minutes so two invitees cannot book the same hour.

2.title: Transfer per your instructions
2.body: Your event type shows bank details, amount, and how to pay. SchedFlow never runs card checkout for guests.

3.title: Upload receipt
3.body: Invitees attach a photo or PDF from the booking page. You get a notification when review is needed.

4.title: Approve to confirm
4.body: Approve the receipt to confirm the booking, or reject with a reason so they can upload again.

scheduling.title: Availability that behaves like a practice, not a spreadsheet
scheduling.body: Each host gets weekly rules, split shifts, and date overrides in an IANA timezone. Event types add buffers, minimum notice, max days ahead, and a daily cap. Slots are generated in UTC; the invitee picks in their own zone.

homeFaqs.q: Can I collect payment proof on the free plan?
homeFaqs.a: Yes. Payment instructions and receipt upload work on Free. Pro adds memberships, branding, and the API.

homeFaqs.q: Do you process card payments for my clients?
homeFaqs.a: No. Invitees pay you by bank transfer using instructions you provide, then upload a receipt. SchedFlow stores the file for your review — we do not run guest card checkout.

homeFaqs.q: What if someone does not upload a receipt?
homeFaqs.a: A receipt-required slot is held for 30 minutes. If no upload arrives, the hold expires and the time is bookable again.

homeFaqs.q: Do my clients need an account?
homeFaqs.a: Not in this release. Invitees book as guests, then manage, reschedule, or cancel from signed links in email.

homeFaqs.q: Can I embed booking on my own site?
homeFaqs.a: Yes. Inline embed or a popup button, same booking flow as the hosted page. Pro can hide the SchedFlow badge.

homeFaqs.q: Is there a Pro trial or in-app upgrade?
homeFaqs.a: Not yet. Stay on Free indefinitely. Pro self-serve billing and subscription management will appear in Dashboard → Billing when available.

pricingFaqs.a: Annual pricing is two months free versus paying monthly. Pro checkout is not wired in the app yet — pricing may change before launch.

pricingFaqs.q: Is there a platform fee on transfers?
pricingFaqs.a: No. Invitees pay you directly by transfer. SchedFlow does not take a cut of guest transfer payments in this release.

pricingFaqs.q: What happens if I cancel Pro?
pricingFaqs.a: When billing is available, you keep Pro until the period ends, then return to Free. Over-limit event types remain visible but you cannot create new ones.

pricingFaqs.q: Can I invoice enterprise or sign an annual contract?
pricingFaqs.a: Not yet. MVP is self-serve Free or Pro when billing launches — no sales-led checkout in the app today.
Scheduling works globally. Receipt upload is currency-agnostic — you set instructions in your workspace language and currency.
